story.iWant: a reusable module that embeds text via the Voyage AI API and returns 1024-dim vectors
story.soThat: wiki articles can be embedded for vector search in Memgraph

task.title: Create the embedding module voyage-embed.mjs
task.subtask: Create /home/ubuntu/scripts/lib/voyage-embed.mjs
Read VOYAGE_API_KEY from process.env — throw descriptive error if not set
Implement embedText(text, inputType = 'document') — single text embedding
Call Voyage AI API: POST https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings with model voyage-3-large
Pass input_type parameter (document for articles, query for search queries)
Parse response and return the 1024-dimensional embedding array
Validate that returned embedding has exactly 1024 dimensions

task.title: Implement batch embedding
task.subtask: Implement embedBatch(texts, inputType = 'document') — array of texts
Enforce maximum batch size of 128 inputs per call
If input exceeds 128, chunk into multiple API calls automatically
Return array of 1024-dim embeddings in the same order as inputs
Handle partial batch failures — retry failed chunks, return results for successful ones

task.title: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
task.subtask: Wrap API calls in retry logic — max 3 attempts
Implement exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s delays between retries
Retry on HTTP 429 (rate limit), 500, 502, 503, 504 status codes
Throw after 3 failed attempts with descriptive error including status code and response body
Log each retry attempt with attempt number and wait duration

task.title: Implement cost tracking and logging
task.subtask: Parse usage.total_tokens from API response
Log token usage per call to stdout: [voyage-embed] Embedded {n} texts, {tokens} tokens, cost ~${cost}
Calculate approximate cost based on $0.06 per 1M tokens for voyage-3-large
Maintain a session-level token counter accessible via getUsageStats()

task.title: Validate module end-to-end
task.subtask: Test single text embedding — verify 1024 dimensions returned
Test batch embedding with 5 sample texts — verify 5 x 1024-dim arrays returned
Test document vs query input types — verify both succeed
Test with invalid API key — verify descriptive error
Test with empty string input — verify graceful handling

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A VOYAGE_API_KEY environment variable is read from the EC2 instance
The module returns a 1024-dimensional float array from voyage-3-large when called with a text string
The module supports batch embedding (up to 128 inputs per call)
The module distinguishes between document input type (for articles) and query input type (for searches)
The module handles API errors with retries (max 3, exponential backoff)
The module logs token usage for cost tracking

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: VOYAGE_CONFIG: model voyage-3-large, dimensions 1024, batchSize 128, inputTypes: article=document, query=query. Cost: $0.06 per 1M tokens. Average wiki article ~500 tokens. 2000 articles = $0.06 total. Re-embedding after compilation: ~10-50 articles = less than $0.003.

package.name: native-fetch
package.reason: Uses built-in fetch API — no additional HTTP library needed

constraints.constraint: No dependency on Story MY-1.1 or MY-1.2 — this story can run in parallel
Requires VOYAGE_API_KEY environment variable set on EC2 instance
No additional npm dependencies — uses native fetch (Node.js 18+ built-in)
Node.js ESM module (.mjs extension) — must use export syntax
Voyage AI API rate limits — implement exponential backoff to handle 429 responses
Batch size hard limit of 128 inputs per API call — must chunk larger batches automatically
Cost tracking is informational logging only — no persistent storage of usage stats

interface.name: Voyage AI Embeddings API
interface.details: Headers: Authorization: Bearer {VOYAGE_API_KEY}, Content-Type: application/json. Request body: {"model": "voyage-3-large", "input": ["text"], "input_type": "document"|"query"}. Response: {"data": [{"embedding": [...1024 floats...], "index": 0}], "usage": {"total_tokens": N}}.

interface.name: Module Exports
interface.details: embedText(text, inputType='document') returns number[] (1024-dim). embedBatch(texts, inputType='document') returns number[][] (N x 1024-dim). getUsageStats() returns {totalTokens, totalCost, callCount}.

standards.standard: Live API validation — requires VOYAGE_API_KEY to be set for end-to-end tests
Dimension validation — every returned embedding must be exactly 1024 floats
Order preservation — batch embeddings must return in same order as inputs
Error handling — invalid API key, empty input, network failures must produce descriptive errors

locations.location: A test runner script or inline validation in Task 5

ideas.idea: Unset VOYAGE_API_KEY, import module, call embedText — verify descriptive error thrown
Call embedText with sample text — verify returned array has exactly 1024 elements, all numbers
Call embedBatch with 5 texts — verify 5 embeddings returned each with 1024 dims. Call with 200 texts — verify auto-chunking (ceil(200/128) = 2 API calls)
Call embedText with inputType='document' then with inputType='query' — verify both return valid embeddings (embeddings will differ due to asymmetric model)
Mock HTTP 429 response — verify 3 retry attempts with increasing delays. Verify final throw after 3 failures.
After embedText call, call getUsageStats() — verify totalTokens > 0, totalCost > 0, callCount = 1
